### Skip the application pile. Get introduced directly

When there’s mutual fit, Jack and Jill introduce you directly to the company, skipping the application stage altogether; saving you time, stress, and effort.

## Making the job market run like clockwork

Your next career move can change the course of your life. A single hire can change the trajectory of a company.

Jack & Jill brings an AI agent to each side of the market, helping people find the right roles and companies find the right people, with more context, more care and far less noise.

[Join us](https://www.jackandjill.ai/about-us)
